what_to_detect: A leveler's level-range static (conditioned on its level counters lying within N1-N2) gives its creature the range's base power/toughness and abilities while the counters are within the range.
near_miss: A leveler whose level counters are outside the range, its range static inactive and contributing nothing.
record_fields: continuous payload contributions (keywords; pt_boost stays 0 for a SetPower$ static, since LayerContributions reads only the P/T boost table)
acting line script IsPresent$ counters_GE/LE LEVEL

what_to_detect: A leveler's N3+ static (conditioned on at least N3 level counters) gives its creature that level's base power/toughness and abilities while it has N3 or more level counters.
near_miss: A leveler with fewer than N3 level counters, its N3+ static inactive and contributing nothing.
record_fields: continuous payload contributions (keywords; pt_boost stays 0 for a SetPower$ static)
acting line script IsPresent$ counters_GE LEVEL

what_to_detect: A level up candidate is playable at sorcery timing whatever the number of level counters on its permanent.
near_miss: A level up candidate not playable: outside sorcery timing, or unaffordable.
record_fields: candidate acting line (the Level up keyword line)

what_to_detect: A leveler with fewer level counters than its first level symbol's N1 has the power/toughness of its uppermost box and none of its level abilities.
near_miss: A leveler with N1 or more level counters, whose level static sets its base power/toughness.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines (active flag on the level statics)

what_to_detect: A candidate whose target restriction reads power has a leveler card outside the battlefield as a legal target by the power of its uppermost box.
near_miss: Not distinct within the rule: the contrast is a card outside the battlefield whose own power fails the restriction.
